title: SecOps on GDC for Tier 3 Analysts
description: This course gives you a deep dive into the workflows of Tier 3 analysts.

enrichment.summary: Advanced security operations training for Tier 3 SOC analysts working on Google Distributed Cloud environments.

title: Network Observability on Google Cloud
description: This mini-course will empower users to understand Network Observability in Google Cloud to gain comprehensive visibility into their network traffic, proactively identify issues, and optimize their infrastructure. By understanding how Network Observability works in Google Cloud, organizations can ensure seamless application delivery and enhance their overall cloud architecture and operations.

enrichment.summary: Learn to monitor, diagnose, and optimize Google Cloud network traffic and telemetry using native observability tools.

title: Introduction to Generative AI
description: This is an introductory level microlearning course aimed at explaining what Generative AI is, how it is used, and how it differs from traditional machine learning methods. It also covers Google Tools to help you develop your own Gen AI apps.

enrichment.summary: Foundational course introducing Generative AI concepts, LLM architecture, and Google's Generative AI ecosystem.

title: Derive Insights from BigQuery Data
description: Complete the introductory Derive Insights from BigQuery Data skill badge course to demonstrate skills in the following: Write SQL queries.Query public tables.Load sample data into BigQuery.Troubleshoot common syntax errors with the query validator in BigQuery.Create reports in Data Studio by connecting to BigQuery data.

enrichment.summary: Skill badge course covering SQL querying, public dataset exploration, syntax troubleshooting, and Looker Studio reporting in BigQuery.

title: Managing Cloud Infrastructure with Terraform
description: In this Quest, the experienced user of Google Cloud will learn how to describe and launch cloud resources with Terraform, an open source tool that codifies APIs into declarative configuration files that can be shared amongst team members, treated as code, edited, reviewed, and versioned.  In these nine hands-on labs, you will work with example templates and understand how to launch a range of configurations, from simple servers, through full load-balanced applications.

enrichment.summary: Comprehensive course on automating and managing Google Cloud infrastructure using HashiCorp Terraform.

title: Manage Kubernetes in Google Cloud
description: Complete the intermediate Manage Kubernetes in Google Cloud skill badge course to demonstrate skills in the following: managing deployments with kubectl, monitoring and debugging applications on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), and continuous delivery techniques.

enrichment.summary: Skill badge course covering GKE deployment scaling, kubectl application debugging, and metric collection using Managed Prometheus.

title: Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) for Generative AI
description: This course is dedicated to equipping you with the knowledge and tools needed to uncover the unique challenges faced by MLOps teams when deploying and managing Generative AI models, and exploring how Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform empowers AI teams to streamline MLOps processes and achieve success in Generative AI projects.

enrichment.summary: Practice operationalizing, deploying, and monitoring Generative AI models using MLOps best practices on Google Cloud.

title: BigQuery Soccer Data Analysis
description: Learn the fundamentals of writing and executing queries to query soccer data stored in BigQuery tables.

enrichment.summary: Hands-on lab writing complex SQL queries and joins on BigQuery tables to derive statistical insights from soccer match events.

title: Using BigQuery Omni with AWS
description: In this lab, you will run BigQuery analytics on data stored in AWS S3 using BigQuery Omni.

enrichment.summary: Advanced lab configuring BigQuery Omni to query data residing in AWS S3 without data egress or cross-cloud migration.

title: Google DeepMind: AI Research Foundations
description: Google DeepMind’s AI Research Foundations curriculum will deepen your understanding of the AI technologies behind language models like Google Gemini, and will teach you how to build and fine-tune modern language models from the ground up. It is designed for university students and community learners who are proficient in python, and studying computer science, math, physics or other technical subjects.

enrichment.summary: Learning path covering foundational research topics, model architectures, and core principles from Google DeepMind.
